mahesvara.name: Disassemble
mahesvara.description: Fires a crystal round the way he faces — where it lands breaks into blue mist, then rewinds into form.

mahesvara.name: Nullify
mahesvara.description: A cracked-glass barrier flashes up and a ring of runes shatters into nothing.

mahesvara.name: Change Form
mahesvara.description: Reveals his true form and takes flight on crystal wings — press again to return to his base form.

mahesvara.name: Return to Dust
mahesvara.description: Ultimate — the whole plaza breaks into dust, then is restored in a flash of light. True form only.

keira.name: Pixel Blink
keira.description: Glitches out and pops back in a short hop toward where you point.

keira.name: Blaze Code
keira.description: A wide pink flame-sword slash toward where you point — her guardian punches along.

keira.name: Combine
keira.description: Her guardian breaks into plates and fuses onto her as armour — press again to separate.

keira.name: Guardian Protocol
keira.description: Ultimate — all systems unlocked: a huge pink blast tears across the plaza. Combined only.

azrenth.name: Eyes of Ruin
azrenth.description: His gaze erases what it falls on — the ground where you point cracks and crumbles to ash.

azrenth.name: Black Sun
azrenth.description: A black-flame sun forms in his palm and is hurled where you point — black fire explodes.

azrenth.name: Summon Venuzdonoa
azrenth.description: The ground tears open and the reason-destroying sword rises from the shadow to hover at his side — press again to send it back.

azrenth.name: Venuzdonoa: Sever
azrenth.description: Ultimate — the golden threads of fate appear across the world, and one slash severs them all. Sword summoned only. Cuts through stopped time.

ayaka.name: Deceleration Zone
ayaka.description: A pale-aqua dome spreads around her for 4 s — anyone inside moves at half speed, trailing afterimages.

ayaka.name: Frost Cadenza
ayaka.description: Point at a player — ice spires race to them in rhythm and lock them in ice for 1 s.

ayaka.name: Niflheim
ayaka.description: Her ice throne rises beneath her and freezing mist rolls out — the ground frosts over and snow swirls.

ayaka.name: Chrono Stasis
ayaka.description: Ultimate — a golden clock ticks once and time stops: everyone else freezes for 3 s while she alone moves.

suvara.name: Crescent Horizon
suvara.description: She draws her sword — a gold-and-teal crescent of light sweeps across the ground toward where you point.

suvara.name: Lantern Ascent
suvara.description: Warm lanterns rise around her and drift into the sky — everyone nearby glows for 4 s.

suvara.name: Yulan, Soar
suvara.description: Ultimate — her light dragon swoops down and carries her to where you point, landing in a burst of radiant wings.

ashvane.name: Dragon Fang
ashvane.description: A spear lunge — he dashes a short hop toward where you point, leaving an amber streak.

ashvane.name: Falling Blossom
ashvane.description: An open-palm strike — a ring of autumn leaves and amber wind bursts out around him.

ashvane.name: Skyfall
ashvane.description: Ultimate — he leaps high and drives his spear down where you point: the ground cracks in a shockwave of leaves.

lucien.name: Rampart of Stone
lucien.description: A stone wall with violet runes rises where you point — nobody can walk through it for 4 s.

lucien.name: Lunar Aegis
lucien.description: A moon-shield sphere forms around him for 4 s — anyone inside can't be slowed or frozen in ice.

lucien.name: Thunder Sovereign
lucien.description: Ultimate — his body becomes lightning: he flashes to where you point and chain lightning strikes around him.

seren.name: Dawn Slash
seren.description: Her crystal sword cuts an arc of golden light toward where you point.

seren.name: Guiding Light
seren.description: Her halo spreads into a warm ring — everyone inside walks 30% faster for 4 s and can't be slowed.

seren.name: Dawnbreak
seren.description: Ultimate — she raises her sword and a pillar of sunrise erupts: the whole world is blinded white, then dawn returns.
